name: Inputs.io
rootCause: In late October 2013, Inputs.io,a centralized Bitcoin web wallet,lost approximately 4,100 BTC (then about $1.2 million) in two major breaches. Attackers gained access to the hosting provider through email account compromise, bypassed security controls, and drained the hot wallet. The attackers compromised administrator email accounts linked to Inputs.io's hosting provider (Linode), allowing password resets, bypassing provider-level two-factor authentication, and gaining full server and hot wallet key access. The absence of substantial offline (cold) storage greatly increased the loss.
